SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGISTRY 7660
Date January 10, 1940.

Subject C. LEONHARD - Communication dated 4.1.40.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by

It is believed that C. LEONARD mentioned in the
attached communication, is identical with C. LEONHARD,
German, employee of Deutsche Farben Waibel, 261
Szechuen Road. Mr. LEONHARD, a resident of Shanghai
for many years, lives with his wife at 21 Edinburgh
Road; there is nothing to his detriment in Police
records.

(It may be of interest to note that the foreigner
alleged to be responsible for the presence of
copies of "Hitler's Reichstag Speech" inserted
in the "Evening Echo" of 7.12.39, was also
an employee of the above mentioned firm, i.e.
"DEFAG.")

D.S. Henchman
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一分署，
报告
档案号 S. B. REGISTRY 7660
日期 1940年1月10日。

事由 C. LEONHARD - 1940年1月4日来函。

呈报人 D.S. Henchman 转呈人

据信，附件来函中提及的 C. LEONARD 与 C. LEONHARD 系同一人，后者为德国人，系四川路261号德商德发洋行（Deutsche Farben Waibel）职员。LEONHARD 先生居沪多年，与其妻同住爱丁堡路21号；警务处档案中并无对其不利之记录。

（值得一提的是，据称负责将1939年12月7日《晚声报》（Evening Echo）中插入的“希特勒国会演说”副本一事的外国人，亦为上述公司即“DEFAG”之职员。）

D.S. Henchman
D. S.

副督察长（特务科）

pages.en:
PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL

I should be grateful for any indications
as to the identity of " C. LECHAND, P.C. Box 1115,
Shanghai". For your confidential information this
P.C. Box is being used to pass correspondence ori-
ginating in Germany to addresses in other countries.

"J"

January 4th., 193..

D.S. Henderson
E.G.

L.S. Amery
(PG)
V.D.
pages.zh:
私密且机密

如能告知“C. LECHAND，上海邮政信箱1115号”之身份线索，不胜感激。供你方机密参考，该邮政信箱正被用于传递源自德国并寄往其他国家地址的信件。

“J”

193..年1月4日

D.S. Henderson
E.G.

L.S. Amery
(PG)
